searchHint: Given or family name (at least 2 letters)
empty: No children match the selected filters.
noLinkedChildren: No children are linked to your account yet. The kindergarten staff links parents to children.
generalNotesHint: Non-sensitive notes only (e.g. brings own blanket). Never enter health data here.
confirmDeactivate: Deactivate the child? Data and history are kept.
noEnrollments: The child is not enrolled in any group yet.
moveHint: The current enrollment ends the day before the chosen date; the new one starts on that date.
cancelPlannedHint: the enrollment has not started and will be cancelled
noParentAccounts: There are no active parent accounts to link. Invite new parents from the Employees screen (Invitations).
linkConfirmedHint: A link created by staff is confirmed at once: from then on the parent sees the child.
revokeHint: The parent loses access to the child immediately (schedule, absences, pickup persons). The reason is recorded.
inviteHint: Invite new parents from the Employees screen (Invitations); after they accept, link them here or confirm the pending link.

pickup.noteHint: E.g. how to recognise the person. No health data.

relationshipTaken: The child already has a linked person in this role (at most one mother and one father).
